rationale:
Issue #161 reports that chunked(by:) evaluated its predicate against the first element of the chunk instead of the immediately preceding element, contradicting the documented consecutive-element contract, with the concrete reproducer [1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9].chunked(by: { $1 - $0 == 1 }) yielding [[1,2],[3,4],[6,7],[8,9]] instead of [[1,2,3,4],[6,7,8,9]]. Traceability is fix_commit -> merged PR #162 ("Fixes #161") -> issue #161, and verified_fix_issue_numbers is [161]. The minimized production patch is exactly three behavioral hunks in Sources/Algorithms/Chunked.swift: endOfChunk(startingAt:) and startOfChunk(endingAt:) change `let subject` to `var subject` and advance it via `defer` inside the predicate closure, and the eager chunked(by:) loop moves `current = element` out of the boundary branch so it updates every iteration. These cover the eager, lazy-forward, and lazy-reverse paths of one defect; no new API, no signature changes, no docs-only, config-only, or test-only content. The one deleted comment line was attached to the rewritten statement it described, so it is part of the fix rather than an unrelated cleanup. The trigger is the unchanged upstream test from the same fixing commit (testChunkedByComparesConsecutiveElements) and asserts precisely the issue's reproducer plus the lazy and reversed variants; it uses only pre-existing API (chunked(by:), .lazy, .reversed(), XCTAssertEqualSequences, validateIndexTraversals), so this is a genuine behavioral FAIL_TO_PASS rather than a fix-only-API compile failure. Strict machine evidence for both the original and post-minimization states passes every gate: build.both_versions, selectors.present_and_unique (1/1 unique), trigger.buggy_differential with the declared selector reproduced, trigger.deterministic across 3 repetitions (32 matrix runs), trigger.fixed_clean, full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers, and full_suite.fixed_all_green. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so #161 is not a duplicate, and it is the only allowed root cause id.

Issue #161 reports that chunked(by:) evaluated its predicate against the first element of the chunk rather than the immediately preceding element, contradicting the documented contract, with the concrete example [1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9].chunked(by: { $1 - $0 == 1 }) yielding [[1,2],[3,4],[6,7],[8,9]] instead of [[1,2,3,4],[6,7,8,9]]. PR #162 states 'Fixes #161' and traceability resolves fix_commit_to_merged_pr_to_issue for issue 161, which matches the single allowed root cause key. All three retained hunks in Sources/Algorithms/Chunked.swift implement exactly that single root cause: endOfChunk(startingAt:) and startOfChunk(endingAt:) change 'let subject' to 'var subject' and advance it via 'defer { subject = nextSubject }' inside the predicate closure, and the eager chunked(by:) loop moves 'current = element' out of the boundary branch so it updates every iteration. Nothing else is touched: no new API, no signature or dependency changes, no doc-only or config-only edits; the single deleted comment line is the comment attached to the rewritten 'let subject' statement, not an unrelated cleanup. The trigger is the unchanged upstream test testChunkedByComparesConsecutiveElements from the same fixing commit (trigger_reduction.removed_external_dependency=false), and it exercises only pre-existing API surface: chunked(by:), .lazy.chunked(by:), .reversed(), plus the existing XCTAssertEqualSequences and validateIndexTraversals helpers, so it is not a fix-only-API compile artifact. Its assertions restate the issue's exact expected values for the eager path, the lazy forward path, and the lazy reverse path. Strict evidence confirms build.both_versions PASS, trigger.buggy_differential PASS with the single reproduced selector Tests/SwiftAlgorithmsTests/ChunkedTests.swift::testChunkedByComparesConsecutiveElements, trigger.fixed_clean PASS, trigger.deterministic across 3 repetitions, full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers PASS, and full_suite.fixed_all_green PASS, identically in strict_original and strict_post_minimization with post_minimization_validation=PASS and zero removed hunks. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so this root cause duplicates no registry entry.
